title: APL Request v1.0
description: An APL request message. Carried over MCP, REST or SDK; the transport is irrelevant to the contract.

message_id.description: Client-generated UUID. Echoed in the audit event so a caller can correlate its own request with the chain.

sender.description: Who is asking. An APL identity for agents, or a scheme-prefixed identifier for humans and applications.

receiver.description: Target APL identity. Accepts the four-segment form used by the gateway today and the five-segment form defined by the compact pack - see OPEN DECISION APL-1.0-D1.

intent.description: MUST match one entry in the target manifest capabilities array.

human_approved.description: Set only by a trusted surface that actually collected human consent. A caller asserting this about itself is not consent.
